title: tls.rs: private key written world-readable on non-Unix platforms
description: In tls.rs::load_or_generate_cert (line 107-108), the #[cfg(not(unix))] branch uses std::fs::write(key_path, &key_der) which creates the file with default umask-derived permissions. On Windows or other non-Unix platforms this may produce a world-readable private key file. The Unix branch explicitly sets mode 0o600 via OpenOptions::mode. The non-Unix branch has no equivalent. The musl deploy target is Linux (unix), so this does not affect production deployments today, but it is a latent hazard for any developer running tests or building on Windows/macOS.
